items.title: 60499_Garvin Bushell oral history interview
items.q: But I remember -- Fletcher made a lot of mistakes as we all have... Now, Chick Webb, before the advent of Ella Fitzgerald, the band wasn't in demand like it became later on.

ctx.x: Amateur Hour, yes. Then they had productions, chorus lines, comedians, and they had production numbers, and I used to do the arranging for the production numbers. Like you have the big show numbers here with the girls on the pedestals, you know.
Sure, well this is where Ella got her first discovery.
